items.a: Pig Latin is a language game where English words are altered according to simple rules. Move consonants to the end and add "ay", or add "yay" to vowel words. It's been used for centuries as a fun secret code.

items.q: Why does this translator have pig sounds?
items.a: Because it's Pig Latin! We added synthesized oink sounds to make the experience more fun. Click 'Play with Oinks' to hear your translation with pig sound effects mixed in with the speech.

items.q: Can I decode Pig Latin back to English?
items.a: Yes! Use the 'Pig Latin → English' mode to translate back. Our algorithm reverses the transformation to give you the original text.

items.q: Is the Pig Latin translator free?
items.a: Yes, completely free! No sign-up, no limits, no hidden costs. Translate as much as you want and enjoy the oinks!

items.q: Does it work with all words?
items.a: It works with most English words. Some very unusual words or names might not translate perfectly, but standard vocabulary works great.
